main.description: Ask for the floor. A member of the context may while the list is open; an owner may regardless, to enter someone who cannot. Asking twice for the same kind is asking once: the entry already there is returned, so a second tap takes no second place.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such speaker list, or one in a context the caller is not a member of.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The list is closed, or the caller may read the context but is not a member of it.
